title: The fragility of “cultural tendencies” in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Administering adapted cultural psychology scale items and vignettes to LLMs to measure constructs like collectivism versus individualism, attribution bias, and reasoning styles (holistic vs. analytic) using Likert scale ratings and binary judgments.

Comparing the performance and behavioral tendencies of large language models when prompted with equivalent instructions and scenarios in different languages (English vs. Chinese) to test if prompt language induces specific cognitive or social orientations.
